observed: During long workflows the user has no bounded progress surface: no elapsed/last-progress age/output growth/stall classification in the normal compact status, so active vs stranded work looks identical.
expected: AirWorker compact status reports elapsed time and last progress age and names STALLED only after a defined threshold.
evidence: 29.09 user reported >1.5h hang; durable receipts existed but required manual file/process inspection.
reproduction: Start a slow or detached durable job and inspect normal adapter/report output.
proposed_outcome: One-minute-or-slower watchdog/status surface; no process killing by default; actionable wake-card on stall.
